purpose: Teach: 鉄砲/小作/扮/バルブ/チタン/引き寄せ/押し上げ/小国

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦国時代の、本気で、絶対、鉄砲、絶対、伝来、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on how firearms spread during the Sengoku period was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Genuine appreciation in the voice. Measured pace. Slight lean forward — this is a real compliment, not routine praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、小作、絶対、農、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I was really interested in how tenant farmers navigated the Edo period, so I wanted to explore that deeply.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Quiet confidence under the formality. Gratitude that feels earned rather than performed. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史劇で俳優が、本気で、絶対、扮、絶対、する、絶対、人物像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you examined how actors embodied historical figures in period drama — that showed real breadth of thinking.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful. Slight pause before 'breadth' — genuinely considering what she's heard. Tone of someone recognizing unexpected depth. Warm but observational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。工業の、本気で、絶対、バルブ、絶対、技術史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand the history of industrial valve technology because I think those details matter.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No rush in the delivery. Quiet confidence that her research choice was worthwhile. A hint of relief at being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 希少金属の、本気で、絶対、チタン、絶対、利用史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your section on the history of titanium and rare metals — that was genuinely thoughtful work.
lines.style: Steady appreciation. Precise — she's referencing a specific section. Tone of someone who read carefully and noticed. Not effusive, but clearly genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。観光客を、本気で、絶対、引き寄せる、絶対、地域づくり、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I was curious about how communities attract and sustain tourism, and that felt important to examine closely.
lines.style: Quiet certainty in her own direction. Thoughtful pacing. Gratitude without self-consciousness. The voice of someone who knows why she chose what she chose.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物価を、本気で、絶対、押し上げる、絶対、要因、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The factors driving inflation in your economic section — you handled those with real care and nuance.
lines.style: Reflective, specific. Naming a particular section. Slower pace — this is genuine observation, not summary. Tone of someone impressed by how seriously she took the complexity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地理的に、本気で、絶対、小国、絶対、の、絶対、外交史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I was really drawn to how smaller nations had to think differently about diplomacy, historically speaking.
lines.style: Sincere and direct. Quiet satisfaction in having explored something meaningful. Gratitude that feels complete. Slight ease in the delivery — this conversation feels safe.
